text: {"name":"hci_process_connection_result","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Checks handler 6 and, for result 9, emits connection-related messages and updates the per-connection context; for result 10, resets the controller.","subsystem":"hci","var_renames":{"v1":"connection_record","v2":"connection_env","v3":"context_index","v4":"connection_event_msg","v5":"connection_context","v6":"derived_link_mode","v7":"swapped_field","v8":"link_reset_msg"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":61,"meaning":"Connection index used to select the per-link environment."},{"offset":116,"meaning":"Index used to select a per-connection context."},{"offset":1208,"meaning":"Bit 0 determines the 1-or-2 link-mode value written to the context."},{"offset":52,"meaning":"16-bit value byte-swapped before being stored in the connection context."}]}
